changed.title: Two full parity supports and a cyclic run weight describe the entire support census through the singular crossover
changed.statement:
∀ T D : ℕ → ℕ, Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
  (∀ k, 2 ≤ D k) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (6*(T k : ℝ))/(2 : ℝ)^(D k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (D k : ℝ)/(6*(T k : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ =>
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let t := T k
  let d := D k
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let a := 3*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let next := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let h := fun (i : Fin n) (b : Fin 4) =>
    if i.val % 2 = b.val / 2 ∧ (i.val / 2 % 3 = b.val % 2 ∨ i.val / 2 % 3 = 2)
    then (1:F) else 0
  let good := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ b : Fin 4, (∑ i, h i b * x i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, x i * y (next i) = x (next i) * y i)
  let supp := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ∃ x ∈ U, x i ≠ 0)
  let spaces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Submodule F W)).filter good
  let layer := spaces.filter (fun U : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F U = d)
  let B := ∏ i ∈ Finset.range d, (2^d-2^i : ℕ)
  let s := (2 : ℝ)^d
  let lane := fun b : Fin 2 => Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val % 2 = b.val)
  let runs := fun S : Finset (Fin n) => (S.filter (fun i => next i ∉ S)).card
  let model := fun S : Finset (Fin n) =>
    (if S = lane 0 then s^(a-2) else 0) + (if S = lane 1 then s^(a-2) else 0) +
    (s-1)^(runs S)/s^4
  let actual := fun S : Finset (Fin n) => (B : ℝ) *
    ((layer.filter (fun U => supp U = S)).card : ℝ)
  (∑ S : Finset (Fin n), |actual S - model S|)/(∑ S : Finset (Fin n), model S))
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

changed.title: Separated even-lane query kernels outperform consecutive pins exactly three through eight questions short of recovery
changed.statement:
∀ (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j+3 ≤ t →
  let h := 3*t-2-j
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  let ix := fun j : ℕ => (⟨j % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.zero_lt_succ 5) ht)⟩ : Fin n)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (w : W) (i : Fin n) => w (ix (i.val + n - s % n))
  let out := fun (name c raw : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 raw + name
    let y := fun j : Fin n => old j + old (ix (j.val+2)) + old (ix (j.val+n-2))
    y i + (1+y (ix (i.val+1)))*y (ix (i.val+2)) + rot 4 raw i + c i
  let mix := fun (w : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 w
    old i + old (ix (i.val+2)) + old (ix (i.val+n-2))
  let a := 3*t
  let evenBit := fun (w : W) (i : Fin a) => mix w (ix (2*i.val))
  let next := fun (i : Fin a) => (⟨(i.val+1) % a, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos 2) ht)⟩ : Fin a)
  ∀ name c : W,
    let win := fun (spaced : Bool) (k : ℕ) =>
      ∃ (v : Fin h → Fin a → F) (A : ℕ → W →ₗ[F] W) (b : ℕ → W),
        let q := fun (i : Fin h) (w : W) => ∑ s, v i s * evenBit w s
        let live := fun (s : Fin a) => ∃ w : W, (∀ i, q i w = 0) ∧ evenBit w s ≠ 0
        let run := fun w : W =>
          (List.finRange h).foldl (fun u i => 2*u + (if q i w = 0 then 0 else 1)) (0 : ℕ)
        (spaced = true → ∀ s, ¬ (live s ∧ live (next s))) ∧
        (spaced = false → ∀ i w, q i w = mix w (ix (2*i.val))) ∧
        k ≤ Nat.card {w : W // out name c w = A (run w) w + b (run w)}
    (∀ k, win true k ↔ 8^(j+1)*k ≤ (5^(j+1)+3^(j+1))*2^n) ∧
      ((∃ k, win true k ∧ ¬ win false k) ↔ 3 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ 8) ∧
      ((∃ k, win false k ∧ ¬ win true k) ↔ 9 ≤ j)

changed.title: One random tape finds full optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions at every attainable size and signed agreement score simultaneously
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)
let bits := fun (w z : Nat) => (List.range w).map (fun h => z.testBit h)
let pairs := fun k : Nat => (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i =>
    ((List.finRange k).filter (fun j => decide (i < j))).map (fun j => (i,j)))
∃ (search : List Bool → List Bool) (d : Nat), fast search ∧
∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (hard : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)))
    (soft : List ((Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)) × Bool)),
  let m := soft.length
  let ends := fun e : Fin n × Fin n => ({e.1,e.2} : Finset (Fin n))
  let E := (pairs n).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    ∀ z ∈ hard, ¬(ends e ⊆ z.1) ∧ ¬(ends e ⊆ z.2))
  let lists := fun (S : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (t : (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)) × Bool) =>
    Disjoint t.1.1 t.1.2 ∧ ∀ e ∈ S, ends e ⊆ t.1.1 ∨ ends e ⊆ t.1.2
  (∀ S ⊆ E, 2 ≤ S.card →
    (∀ e ∈ S, ∀ f ∈ S, e ≠ f → Disjoint (ends e) (ends f)) →
    (soft.filter (fun t => t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length =
      (soft.filter (fun t => !t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R T : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ T))
  let valid := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    ∀ z ∈ hard, obs f z.1 z.2 = false
  let code := fun f : Fn => (pairs n).map (fun e => obs f (ends e) ∅)
  let size := fun f : Fn => ((code f).filter id).length
  let score := fun f : Fn => (soft.filter (fun t => decide (obs f t.1.1 t.1.2 = t.2))).length
  let bank := fun B : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ B))
  let input := header n ++ header hard.length ++ hard.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2) ++
    header m ++ soft.flatMap (fun t => bank t.1.1 ++ bank t.1.2 ++ [t.2])
  ∀ a : Nat, 1 ≤ a →
    let prefixBits := header a ++ input
    let ell := (prefixBits.length+2)^d
    let slots := (List.finRange (n/2+1)).flatMap (fun s =>
      (List.finRange (m+1)).map (fun j => (s,j)))
    let enc := fun word : List Bool => if word.isEmpty then List.replicate ((pairs n).length+1) false
      else true::word
    let belongs := fun (f : Fn) (s : Fin (n/2+1)) (j : Fin (m+1)) =>
      valid f ∧ size f = s.val ∧ score f = j.val
    ∃ words : (Fin ell → Bool) → Fin (n/2+1) → Fin (m+1) → List Bool,
      (∀ tape, search (prefixBits ++ List.ofFn tape) =
        slots.flatMap (fun z => enc (words tape z.1 z.2))) ∧
      (∀ tape s j, words tape s j ≠ [] → ∃ f : Fn, belongs f s j ∧ words tape s j = code f) ∧
      2^a * Nat.card {tape : Fin ell → Bool // ∀ s j, (∃ f : Fn, belongs f s j) →
        words tape s j ≠ []} ≥ (2^a-1)*2^ell

changed.title: One signed trace counts arbitrary parity reports on equally spaced cyclic sensors
changed.statement:
∀ (k r m q s d : Nat), 4 ≤ r → 2 ≤ q → 0 < s → k = q*s → s ≤ d → d < 2*s →
  let u := d-s
  let rot := fun (h w : Nat) =>
    ((w <<< (h % k)) ||| (w >>> (k - h % k))) % 2^k
  let step := fun (w : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i => acc ||| ((xor (w.testBit i)
      (!(w.testBit ((i+1)%k)) && w.testBit ((i+2)%k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let state := fun (col : Bool) (w name : Nat) (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    let g := if col then 2 else 1
    (List.finRange r).foldl (fun x j =>
      step (x ^^^ rot g x ^^^ rot (k-g) x) ^^^
        rot (if col then 3*(j.val+1)+1 else 2*j.val) w ^^^ (c j).val)
      (rot (if col then 3 else 1) w ^^^ name)
  let reach := fun col : Bool => if col then 7*r-2 else 5*r-3
  let delay := fun col : Bool => if col then 3*r+1 else 2*r-2
  let sign := fun b : Bool => if b then (-1 : ℤ) else 1
  let bits := fun (a x : Nat) => (List.range a).map (fun i => x.testBit i)
  let sched := fun (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun j => bits k (c j).val)
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (3*k+2*r*k+q+m*q+m+(k+1)) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 2^44*(k+r+m+5)^16*(2^(s-1+u)+2^(3*u)) ∧
    ∀ (nr nc : Fin (2^k)) (cr cc : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) (off : Fin k) (bank : Fin q → Bool),
      let p := fun i : Fin q => (off.val+i.val*s)%k
      let sensor := fun (i : Fin q) (w : Nat) =>
        (state (bank i) w (if bank i then nc.val else nr.val)
          (if bank i then cc else cr)).testBit ((p i + delay (bank i))%k)
      let valid := ∀ i, reach (bank i) ≤ d
      let K := fun (i : Fin q) (a b : Fin (2^u)) =>
        ∑ z : Fin (2^(s-1)),
          if z.val % 2^u = a.val then
            let h := fun (t : Bool) => sensor i (rot (p i)
              ((z.val <<< 1) ||| (t.toNat <<< s) ||| (b.val <<< (s+1))))
            if h false = h true then (0 : ℤ) else sign (h false)
          else 0
      let D := Matrix.trace ((List.ofFn
        (fun i : Fin q => (K i : Matrix (Fin (2^u)) (Fin (2^u)) ℤ))).prod)
      (valid → ∀ y : Fin q → Bool,
        ((Nat.card {w : Fin (2^k) // ∀ i, sensor i w.val = y i}) : ℤ) =
          (2 : ℤ)^(k-q) + sign ((List.ofFn y).foldl xor false) * D) ∧
      ∀ (A : Fin m → Fin (2^q)) (v : Fin m → Bool) (t : Fin (2^(k+1))),
        let obs := fun (w : Nat) (j : Fin m) => (List.finRange q).foldl
          (fun b i => xor b ((A j).val.testBit i.val && sensor i w)) false
        let hits := Nat.card {w : Fin (2^k) // ∀ j, obs w.val j = v j}
        let masks := (List.finRange m).flatMap (fun j => bits q (A j).val)
        C.eval (bits k nr.val ++ bits k nc.val ++ sched cr ++ sched cc ++ bits k off.val ++
          List.ofFn bank ++ masks ++ List.ofFn v ++ bits (k+1) t.val) =
            decide (valid ∧ t.val ≤ hits)
